_assumptions.cabin_box: ASSUMED 5.33 m long x 1.45 m high (TM-85722 via PAIN_Program/docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) x 1.45 m wide (width not printed: square section assumed); cabin from station 60.5, prop plane (station 117) 1.435 m aft of its front
_assumptions.fuselage_radius: ASSUMED 0.725 m (as V5): scattering factor and patch curvature only
_assumptions.patch_grid: the whole near sidewall (5.33 m x 1.45 m) as a 30 x 15 grid; axial_offset puts the cabin from +1.435 m to -3.895 m about the prop plane
_assumptions.sidewall: 1.6 mm aluminium skin (CR-178004 sec. 2.1); stiffener mass, windows and frames not modelled (not printed); flat (curved = false): rectangular section
_assumptions.bare_absorption: alpha = 0.075 on all bare surfaces: midpoint of the 0.05 and 0.1 the report itself assumed (sec. 6.3)
_assumptions.treated_absorption: CR-178004 Table 11: sidewall treatment alpha, cockpit curtain alpha (used for the barrier's foam face), seat with occupant sabins (4 seats); 63 and 8000 Hz octaves hold the end values
_assumptions.blanket: 5 cm Insul-Shield, 48 kg/m3 (sec. 2.4), directly on the skin with no trim; flow resistivity ASSUMED 25 000 Pa s/m2 (not printed)
_assumptions.tbl_station: ASSUMED nose-to-microphone distance 2.91 m = station 114.5 in (Table 8), taking station 0 at the nose
_assumptions.airspeed: TAS from IAS taking IAS = EAS; density from pressure altitude and OAT
_assumptions.cabin_air: cabin pressure altitude from Table 4; 293.15 K assumed
_assumptions.two_rpm: the pipeline holds one rpm per run, so each engine is run on its own (engines = 2, energetic = its near-side and shadow-side paths) and the components are added in energy
_assumptions.n_tau: 1024 samples per revolution (harmonics up to 10 x 3 blades)

_conditions: CR-178004 Table 4 (flight 3): pressure altitude, IAS, OAT, rpm, power, cabin pressure altitude (ft columns)
_exterior: App. A flight 3 surface levels at the near flush microphone; converted to incident with |S(ka,0)| (a = 0.725 m) and anchored at the microphone (measured_ref)
